statements.text: NASA/ESA/CSA JWST, MIRI GTO programme 1193 (PI G. Rieke); Gáspár et al. 2023, Nature Astronomy 7, 790 (arXiv:2305.03789), reduced images from github.com/merope82/Fomalhaut

The authors publish their reduced images for download with the paper (its Data Availability statement) and state no licence; they derive from JWST data that carry no copyright. The files are fetched at preparation time, pinned by sha256, and not redistributed; the rendered volume credits the authors and the mission.
